name: skopeo
description: Container image inspection and manipulation tool without requiring a container runtime

skopeo.description: Inspect, copy, and manage container images across registries without Docker daemon
skopeo.usage:
skopeo inspect docker://alpine:latest
skopeo copy docker://alpine:latest oci:./alpine
skopeo list-tags docker://nginx
skopeo delete docker://registry.com/image:tag
skopeo sync --src docker --dest dir registry.com/repo ./backup
